description: Header file defining the QuicCryptoClientHandshaker class, which implements the handshake protocol for QUIC crypto within the Chromium project. It declares methods and members related to QUIC cryptographic handshake management.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
classes.description: Implements the handshake protocol for QUIC crypto, managing the state and process of establishing a secure connection.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Callback class for asynchronous proof verification results within QuicCryptoClientHandshaker.

methods.name: num_sent_client_hellos
methods.description: Returns the number of ClientHello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Indicates if session resumption is being used.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for early data acceptance or rejection.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if an inchoate reject was received.

methods.name: num_scup_messages_received
methods.description: Returns the number of SCUP messages received.

methods.name: chlo_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the last ClientHello message.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Indicates if encryption has been established.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if a crypto frame is expected at a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Gets the encryption level for sending crypto data in a specific packet space.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances cryptographic keys and creates a decrypter for 1-RTT data.
